description: This file contains utility functions related to internationalization (i18n) for a documentation system, including functions for hashing, normalization, environment variable configuration, and segment ID generation.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a namespace string based on workflow version, engine name, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash-based cache key from namespace, source and target languages, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of normalized text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the provided byte slice.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace from input text and normalizes internal whitespace.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the provider name based on environment variables, with fallbacks.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the model name based on environment variables and provider.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID combining a relative path and truncated text hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input text into leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error and terminates the program if the error is non-nil.
